tasks.label: SigMixa: copy sample for debug
tasks.detail: Debugging opens a fresh copy of sample/ (work/debug-sample, git-ignored), so view settings saved while debugging never change the sample itself. Large logs are linked, not copied.
tasks.command: rm -rf work/debug-sample && mkdir -p work && rsync -a --exclude large-logs sample/ work/debug-sample/ && { [ ! -d sample/large-logs ] || ln -s ../../sample/large-logs work/debug-sample/large-logs; }
